_comment: Pear project links + (future) multisig config. Multisig is intentionally NOT set up: we're a solo publisher, the deprecated `pear release` still works, and a 1-of-1 quorum adds ceremony without security. When we get a co-signer (or Pear actually removes `pear release`), add the publicKeys + namespace + quorum block here and switch scripts/release-prod.sh to the provision+multisig path.
